newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: S.Korea's Yukong to shut two reformers January 24.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong to shut two reformers January 24.

text.p: South Korean refiner Yukong Ltd is planning to cut its 60,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) reformer production by 25,000-bpd by closing two units for 10 to 15 days from January 24, industry sources said on Thursday.
They said a Yukong's reformer 10,000-bpd No.1 and 15,000-bpd No.2 will be shutdown due poor reforming margins.
"The naphtha price is very expensive compared with the gasoline and BTX prices," said a source on the relative feedstock and reformimg product costs.
He said it would be better to sell the feedstock, one cargo of heavy naphtha, instead of reforming it.
After 10 to 15 days, the company may consider an extension of the shutdown period.
Yukong had earlier this month just restarted the No.2 reformer after shutting it down for a month when margins were similarly bad.
Yukong is the country's largest refiner at 810,000-bpd.
